Mctt.Core.Syntactic.Unseal

Unsealing a Global Context

abstract only hides a body from conversion: an opaque definition still has one. Unsealing a global context makes every definition with a body transparent, and leaves axioms and everything else as they are.
The transparency flag is read only where a stored definition is read as a term description (edenote): an opaque one has no δ-reduct. So unsealing changes what a lookup reads only by giving such a definition its δ-reduct, and a stored body by unsealing it (mdesc_unsealed): every judgment, the global ones included, survives unsealing (unseal_preserves_wf). A stored definition is a function of its module's telescope, and is given at most that many arguments, so its δ-reduct, once there, can be given them too (ats_term_unseal).
A global context without axioms (gc_no_axioms) unseals to a transparent one (gc_no_axioms_unseal_transparent), which is what consistency and canonicity are proved at.

From Stdlib Require Import List String.

From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import SystemOpt.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System Require Import Definitions Command.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Global Require Import MemberWf LookupSound.
Import Syntax_Notations Wk_Notations GlobalCtx_Notations.
#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

Unsealing

The flag of a definition once unsealed: transparent when it has a body.
Definition flag_unseal (b : bool) (B : option exp) : bool :=
  match B with
  | Some _ => true
  | None => b
  end.

An entry unsealed: every definition with a body made transparent, at every depth of nesting; mutually, for module bodies.
Fixpoint ge_unseal (E : gentry) : gentry :=
  match E with
  | ge_def b pv r A B => ge_def (flag_unseal b B) pv r A B
  | ge_mod pv (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ)) => ge_mod pv (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm (gm_unseal Φ)))
  | ge_mod pv U => ge_mod pv U
  | ge_ind pv p k D Φ => ge_ind pv p k D (gm_unseal Φ)
  | ge_def_mod pv A M U => ge_def_mod pv A M U
  | ge_record pv p R Φ => ge_record pv p R (gm_unseal Φ)
  end
with gm_unseal (Φ : gmod) : gmod :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => gm_nil
  | gm_ext Φ x E => gm_ext (gm_unseal Φ) x (ge_unseal E)
  | gm_open Φ H its Φg => gm_open (gm_unseal Φ) H its (gm_unseal Φg)
  end.

An alias has no definition of its own, so it is unchanged.
Definition gu_unseal (U : gunit) : gunit :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ) => gu_mk Δ (md_body sm (gm_unseal Φ))
  | _ => U
  end.

Fixpoint gds_unseal (Θ : gdeps) : gdeps :=
  match Θ with
  | nil => nil
  | (fp, U) :: Θ => (fp, gu_unseal U) :: gds_unseal Θ
  end.

Fixpoint gs_unseal (Ξ : gstack) : gstack :=
  match Ξ with
  | nil => nil
  | (mp, K, U) :: Ξ => (mp, K, gu_unseal U) :: gs_unseal Ξ
  end.

Lemma gu_params_unseal : forall U, gu_params (gu_unseal U) = gu_params U.
Proof. intros [Δ [Φ | E]]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gu_mod_unseal : forall U, gu_mod (gu_unseal U) = gm_unseal (gu_mod U).
Proof. intros [Δ [Φ | E]]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gs_tele_unseal : forall Ξ, gs_tele (gs_unseal Ξ) = gs_tele Ξ.
Proof. induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity | rewrite gu_params_unseal, IH; reflexivity ]. Qed.

Lemma gm_names_unseal : forall Φ, gm_names (gm_unseal Φ) = gm_names Φ.
Proof. induction Φ; cbn; congruence. Qed.

Lemma gm_fresh_unseal : forall x Φ, gm_fresh x Φ -> gm_fresh x (gm_unseal Φ).
Proof. unfold gm_fresh; intros; rewrite gm_names_unseal; assumption. Qed.

Resolution Commutes with Unsealing

What a path resolves to is unsealed with the context; what a module path resolves to is not changed at all, since a body module is handed back as its telescope only, and an alias is unchanged.

Lemma gm_resolve_unseal : forall Φ ip,
    gm_resolve (gm_unseal Φ) ip = option_map ge_unseal (gm_resolve Φ ip).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | | apply IH ].
  destruct ip as [| x ip']; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IH ].
  destruct ip' as [| z ip''], E as [b pv A B | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ?]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma gm_entry_unseal : forall Φ ip,
    gm_entry (gm_unseal Φ) ip = option_map ge_unseal (gm_entry Φ ip).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | | apply IH ].
  destruct ip as [| x ip']; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IH ].
  destruct ip' as [| z ip''], E as [b pv A B | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ?]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma gm_submodule_unseal : forall Φ T x ip,
    gm_submodule T (gm_unseal Φ) x ip = gm_submodule T Φ x ip.
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] T x ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | | apply IH ].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IH ].
  destruct E as [b pv A B | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ?]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    destruct ip; first [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gm_module_unseal : forall Φ T oD ip,
    gm_module T oD (gm_unseal Φ) ip = gm_module T oD Φ ip.
Proof. intros * ; destruct ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | apply gm_submodule_unseal ]. Qed.

Lemma gs_find_unseal : forall Ξ p,
    gs_find (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map (fun r => (gu_unseal (fst r), snd r)) (gs_find Ξ p).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gs_find_tele_unseal : forall Ξ p,
    gs_find_tele (gs_unseal Ξ) p =
      option_map (fun r => let '(U, ip, T) := r in (gu_unseal U, ip, T)) (gs_find_tele Ξ p).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ rewrite gs_tele_unseal; reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

The kinds of the frames are not sealed.
Lemma gs_find_ind_unseal : forall Ξ p, gs_find_ind (gs_unseal Ξ) p = gs_find_ind Ξ p.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [ reflexivity | reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gs_find_record_unseal : forall Ξ p, gs_find_record (gs_unseal Ξ) p = gs_find_record Ξ p.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [ reflexivity | reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gds_lookup_unseal : forall Θ fp,
    gds_lookup (gds_unseal Θ) fp = option_map gu_unseal (gds_lookup Θ fp).
Proof.
  induction Θ as [| [fq U] Θ IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (path_beq fp fq); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gc_resolve_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p,
    gc_resolve (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map ge_unseal (gc_resolve Θ Ξ p).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u; rewrite gs_find_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip] |]; cbn; [ rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_resolve_unseal |].
  rewrite gds_lookup_unseal.
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); cbn; [ rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_resolve_unseal | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Lemma gc_resolve_unseal_def : forall Θ Ξ p b pv r A B,
    gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def b pv r A B) ->
    gc_resolve (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = Some (ge_def (flag_unseal b B) pv r A B).
Proof. intros * H; rewrite gc_resolve_unseal, H; reflexivity. Qed.

A transparent definition stays as it is.
Lemma gc_resolve_unseal_transparent : forall Θ Ξ p pv r A M,
    gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def true pv r A (Some M)) ->
    gc_resolve (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = Some (ge_def true pv r A (Some M)).
Proof. intros * H; exact (gc_resolve_unseal_def _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H). Qed.

An inductive declaration is not sealed.
Lemma gc_module_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p,
    gc_module (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = gc_module Θ Ξ p.
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_module, gc_module_u; rewrite gs_find_tele_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T] |]; cbn; [ reflexivity | |].
  - rewrite gu_params_unseal, gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_submodule_unseal.
  - rewrite gds_lookup_unseal.
    destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); cbn; [| reflexivity ].
    rewrite gu_params_unseal, gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_module_unseal.
Qed.

Lemma ind_mlookup_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p, ind_mlookup (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = ind_mlookup Θ Ξ p.
Proof. intros; rewrite !ind_mlookup_unfold, gs_find_ind_unseal, gc_module_unseal; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ind_lookup_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p, ind_lookup (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = ind_lookup Θ Ξ p.
Proof. intros; rewrite !ind_lookup_unfold, ind_mlookup_unseal; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gc_entry_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p,
    gc_entry (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map ge_unseal (gc_entry Θ Ξ p).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_entry, gc_entry_u; rewrite gs_find_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip] |]; cbn; [ rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_entry_unseal |].
  rewrite gds_lookup_unseal.
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); cbn; [ rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_entry_unseal | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Unsealing leaves the declaration of a record as it is.
Lemma record_lookup_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p, record_lookup (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = record_lookup Θ Ξ p.
Proof.
  intros; unfold record_lookup; rewrite gs_find_record_unseal, gc_entry_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p); [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (gc_entry Θ Ξ p) as [[| ? [? []] | | |] |]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Freshness


Lemma frame_fresh_unseal : forall Θ Ξ mp,
    frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp -> frame_fresh (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) mp.
Proof.
  intros * H; destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] U] Ξ]; cbn in *.
  - destruct H as [Hn Hc]; split; [ rewrite gds_lookup_unseal, Hn; reflexivity | assumption ].
  - destruct H as (x & -> & Hx); exists x; split; [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_fresh_unseal; assumption.
Qed.

Members

Stored Modules under Unsealing

A stored body reads, unsealed, as the body unsealed.

Definition pair_unseal (r : (ctx * gmod)%type) : (ctx * gmod)%type := (fst r, gm_unseal (snd r)).

Lemma gm_subbody_unseal : forall Φ T x ip,
    gm_subbody T (gm_unseal Φ) x ip = option_map pair_unseal (gm_subbody T Φ x ip).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] T x ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | | apply IH ].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IH ].
  destruct E as [b pv A B | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? D Φ' | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ?]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    destruct ip; first [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gm_body_unseal : forall T Φ ip, gm_body T (gm_unseal Φ) ip = option_map pair_unseal (gm_body T Φ ip).
Proof. intros * ; destruct ip; cbn; [ reflexivity | apply gm_subbody_unseal ]. Qed.

Lemma gc_body_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p,
    gc_body (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map pair_unseal (gc_body Θ Ξ p).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_body; rewrite gs_find_tele_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T] |]; cbn; [ reflexivity | |].
  - rewrite gu_params_unseal, gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_subbody_unseal.
  - rewrite gds_lookup_unseal.
    destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); cbn; [| reflexivity ].
    rewrite gu_params_unseal, gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_body_unseal.
Qed.

Lemma gc_frame_unseal : forall Ξ p, gc_frame (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map pair_unseal (gc_frame Ξ p).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_frame; rewrite gs_find_tele_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ | E]] [| x ip]] T] |]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma gc_loc_unseal : forall Θ Ξ p, gc_loc (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) p = option_map pair_unseal (gc_loc Θ Ξ p).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_loc; rewrite gc_frame_unseal.
  destruct (gc_frame Ξ p); [ reflexivity | apply gc_body_unseal ].
Qed.

Lemma gc_unit_unseal : forall Θ Ξ H, gc_unit (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) H = option_map pair_unseal (gc_unit Θ Ξ H).
Proof.
  intros; unfold gc_unit.
  destruct (mod_qname H) as [mp |]; [| reflexivity ].
  rewrite gs_find_tele_unseal, gs_find_ind_unseal, gs_find_record_unseal.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ mp) as [[[U [| x ip]] T] |]; cbn.
  - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]], (gs_find_ind Ξ mp), (gs_find_record Ξ mp); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite gds_lookup_unseal.
    destruct (q_chain mp), (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp)) as [[Δ [[|] Φ | E]] |]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma gm_prefix_upto_unseal : forall Φ x, gm_prefix_upto (gm_unseal Φ) x = option_map gm_unseal (gm_prefix_upto Φ x).
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity | |].
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
  - destruct (existsb _ _); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma gm_noopen_unseal : forall Φ, gm_noopen Φ -> gm_noopen (gm_unseal Φ).
Proof. induction Φ; cbn; tauto. Qed.

Lemma ge_read_unseal : forall T E, ge_read T (ge_unseal E) = ge_unseal (ge_read T E).
Proof. intros T [| ? [? [[] ?| ?]] | | |]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma entry_is_body_unseal : forall E, entry_is_body E -> entry_is_body (ge_unseal E).
Proof. intros [| ? [? [[] ?| ?]] | | |]; cbn; tauto. Qed.

Lemma entry_alias_unit_unseal : forall E, entry_alias_unit (ge_unseal E) = entry_alias_unit E.
Proof. intros [| ? [? [[] ?| ?]] | | |]; reflexivity. Qed.

Descriptions under Unsealing

mdesc_unsealed R R': R' is R read in the unsealed context: a definition may have gained its body as its δ-reduct, and a stored body is unsealed.
Inductive mdesc_unsealed : mdesc -> mdesc -> Prop :=
A term may gain a δ-reduct
| mdesc_unsealed_term : forall r A om om', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_term r A om) (mdesc_term r A om')
An open module is unchanged
| mdesc_unsealed_open : forall Δ Φ Φx, mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx) (mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx)
A closed module's stored body is unsealed
| mdesc_unsealed_closed : forall Θ p T Φ Ns, mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns) (mdesc_closed Θ p T (gm_unseal Φ) Ns)
A definition with a module part, or a type former, keeps its term part; its module part, a module, is read unsealed
| mdesc_unsealed_dm : forall Θd A M Rm Rm', mdesc_is_mod Rm -> mdesc_unsealed Rm Rm' -> mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm) (mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm').

#[local] Hint Constructors mdesc_unsealed : core.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_mod : forall R R' Rm, mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    exists Rm', mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm' /\ mdesc_unsealed Rm Rm'.
Proof.
  intros * Hd; revert Rm; induction Hd; intros Rm0 Hm; cbn in Hm |- *; try discriminate; try (injection Hm as <-; eauto).
  all: try (match goal with IH : forall Rm, mdesc_mod _ = Some Rm -> _ |- _ => exact (IH _ Hm) end).
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_tele : forall R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_tele R' = mdesc_tele R.
Proof. intros * []; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_mtele : forall R R' T, mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_mod_tele R = Some T -> mdesc_mod_tele R' = Some T.
Proof.
  intros * Hd Ht; unfold mdesc_mod_tele in *.
  destruct (mdesc_mod R) as [Rm |] eqn:Hm; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd Hm) as (Rm' & -> & Hd'); rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_tele _ _ Hd'); exact Ht.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_ty : forall R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_type R' = mdesc_type R.
Proof. intros * []; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_is_mod : forall R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_is_mod R -> mdesc_is_mod R'.
Proof. intros * []; cbn; tauto. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_up : forall Θ' R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_up Θ' R) (mdesc_up Θ' R').
Proof. intros Θ' R R' Hd; induction Hd; cbn; constructor; [ apply mdesc_is_mod_up |]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_sub : forall σ R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_sub R σ) (mdesc_sub R' σ).
Proof.
  intros σ R R' Hd; induction Hd; cbn; constructor; [| assumption ].
  match goal with Hm : mdesc_is_mod ?R0 |- _ => destruct R0; cbn in Hm |- *; first [ contradiction | exact I ] end.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_self : forall M R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_self M R) (mdesc_self M R').
Proof. intros * [r A [] [] | | | ]; cbn; constructor; assumption. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_named : forall Θ Ns M R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_named Θ Ns M R) (mdesc_named Θ Ns M R').
Proof. intros [|] [|] * Hd; cbn [mdesc_named]; first [ exact Hd | apply mdesc_unsealed_self; exact Hd ]. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_unit : forall R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> mdesc_unit R' = mdesc_unit R.
Proof. intros * [| | [] |]; reflexivity. Qed.

"R at N", for a description that is no term: one that is no term either.
Lemma mdesc_unsealed_at : forall R R' N R1, mdesc_unsealed R R' -> (forall r A om, R <> mdesc_term r A om) -> mdesc_at R N = Some R1 ->
    exists R1', mdesc_at R' N = Some R1' /\ mdesc_unsealed R1 R1' /\ forall r A om, R1 <> mdesc_term r A om.
Proof.
  intros R R' N R1 Hd; revert R1; induction Hd as [| | | Θd A M Rm Rm' Hmm Hd IH]; intros R1 Hn Ha;
    [ exfalso; eapply Hn; reflexivity | | |]; cbn in Ha |- *.
  - destruct (tele_split (rev Δ)) as [[[? ?] ?] |]; [ injection Ha as <-; eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ auto | discriminate ] ] | discriminate ].
  - destruct (tele_split (rev Θ)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; injection Ha as <-; (eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ auto | discriminate ] ]).
  - (* a definition with a module part: its module part at N, and its
       term part filled when there is an outside parameter *)
    assert (Hnm : forall r0 A0 om, Rm <> mdesc_term r0 A0 om) by (intros r0 A0 om ->; exact Hmm).
    destruct (mdesc_at Rm N) as [Rm1 |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (IH _ Hnm eq_refl) as (Rm1' & -> & Hd1 & Hn1).
    pose proof (mdesc_at_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm E) as Hm1.
    destruct (tele_split (rev Θd)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; injection Ha as <-.
    + eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ constructor; assumption | discriminate ] ].
    + exists Rm1'; split; [ reflexivity | split; assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unsealed_ats : forall Ns R R' R1, mdesc_unsealed R R' -> (forall r A om, R <> mdesc_term r A om) -> mdesc_ats R Ns = Some R1 ->
    exists R1', mdesc_ats R' Ns = Some R1' /\ mdesc_unsealed R1 R1'.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Hd Hn Ha; cbn in Ha |- *; [ injection Ha as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (mdesc_at R N) as [R2 |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (mdesc_unsealed_at _ _ _ _ Hd Hn E) as (R2' & -> & Hd2 & Hn2).
  exact (IH _ _ _ Hd2 Hn2 Ha).
Qed.

A stored definition, given arguments for its telescope: its body, a function of the telescope, is too.
Lemma ats_term_unseal : forall Ns r T A0 M0 R1, all_assumptions T -> List.length Ns <= List.length T ->
    mdesc_ats (mdesc_term r (ctx_pi_at r T A0) None) Ns = Some R1 ->
    exists R1', mdesc_ats (mdesc_term r (ctx_pi_at r T A0) (Some (ctx_fn T M0))) Ns = Some R1' /\ mdesc_unsealed R1 R1'.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Ha Hl Hats; cbn in Hats |- *; [ injection Hats as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (List.exists_last (l := T)) as (T1 & e & ->); [ intros ->; cbn in Hl; lia |].
  unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply List.Forall_app in Ha as [Ha1 He]; inversion He as [| ? ? (κ & C & ->) _]; subst.
  rewrite ctx_pi_app in Hats |- *; rewrite ctx_fn_app; cbn [ctx_pi ctx_fn pi_view fn_view] in Hats |- *.
  rewrite ctx_pi_sub in Hats |- *; rewrite ctx_fn_sub.
  apply (IH r (tele_sub T1 (Id,,N))); [ apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha1 | rewrite length_tele_sub; rewrite length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl; lia | exact Hats ].
Qed.

mdesc_unseal_struct R: the unsealing of a description that is no term: a closed module's stored body unsealed, the module part of a definition with a module part unsealed, an open module unchanged. A term is left as it is: unsealed it may gain its δ-reduct, which its description does not give, so mdesc_unsealed is no function at a term. The member descriptions ⊢ⁿˡ reads are never terms, so they unseal by this function. For a closed M = { def d : ℕ ≔ 0 (opaque); module K ≔ … } the premises read only K's entry, whose description mdesc_closed nil q T Φk nil unseals to mdesc_closed nil q T (gm_unseal Φk) nil; d is a definition, read by its type.
Fixpoint mdesc_unseal_struct (R : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns => mdesc_closed Θ p T (gm_unseal Φ) Ns
  | mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm => mdesc_dm Θd A M (mdesc_unseal_struct Rm)
  | _ => R
  end.

At a description that is no term, unsealing is that function.
Lemma mdesc_unsealed_struct_of_non_term : forall R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' ->
    (forall r A om, R <> mdesc_term r A om) -> R' = mdesc_unseal_struct R.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [r A om om' | | | Θd A M Rm Rm' Hm Hu IH]; intros Hn; cbn [mdesc_unseal_struct]; try reflexivity.
  - exfalso; exact (Hn r A om eq_refl).
  - rewrite IH; [ reflexivity |]; intros r A0 om E; subst; cbn in Hm; exact Hm.
Qed.

Lookup under Unsealing

What a well-formed module expression denotes, it denotes unsealed up to mdesc_unsealed; a stored unit or entry is read unsealed.

Definition unit_at (o : option qname) (U : gunit) : gunit :=
  match o with
  | Some _ => gu_unseal U
  | None => U
  end.

Definition entry_at (o : option qname) (E : gentry) : gentry :=
  match o with
  | Some _ => ge_unseal E
  | None => E
  end.

Definition modexp_unseal_precondition (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (H : modexp) : Prop :=
  Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H \/ exists H0 x, H = me_mem H0 x /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0.

Definition body_unseal_precondition (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (Φ Φx : gmod) : Prop :=
  forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H.

Definition gunit_unseal_precondition (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (o : option qname) (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δ (md_alias E) => Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E
  | gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ) =>
      match o with
      | Some _ => sm = sm_closed /\ gm_noopen Φ
      | None => forall Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx -> body_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx
      end
  end.

What an entry's unit, a module's or the module part of a definition with a module part, needs.
Definition gentry_unseal_precondition (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (o : option qname) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  forall pv U, (E = ge_mod pv U \/ exists A M, E = ge_def_mod pv A M U) -> gunit_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ o U.

Lemma gunit_unseal_precondition_full : forall Θ Ξ Γ U, unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U -> gunit_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ None U.
Proof.
  intros * Hf; destruct U as [Δ [[] Φ | E]]; cbn in Hf |- *; try contradiction.
  - destruct Hf as [Φx es lv ps Hps Hx HC _ _ _ Ho].
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HC) as Hg.
    intros Φx' Hx'; rewrite <- (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ Hx').
    exact Ho.
  - destruct Hf as [? ? ? ? ? HE]; exact HE.
Qed.

Lemma edenote_term_inv : forall Θ Ξ Γ o E r A om, edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E (mdesc_term r A om) ->
    exists b pv oM, E = ge_def b pv r A oM /\ om = (if b then oM else None).
Proof.
  intros * Hd; inversion Hd; subst; eauto.
  match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => pose proof (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as Hm; contradiction end.
Qed.

Lemma ge_read_def : forall T E b pv r A oM, ge_read T E = ge_def b pv r A oM -> E = ge_def b pv r A oM.
Proof. intros T [| ? [? [[] ?| ?]] | | |] * H; cbn in H; congruence. Qed.

An entry stored at a location, read as it is stored, is read alike unsealed: it is closed and valid there, so a body it holds is closed with no open, and an alias it holds is a well-formed module expression over its parameters, in any well-formed Γ.
Lemma closed_entry_unseal_precondition : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ p T Φ y Φ0 E1 R,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E1) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E1) R ->
    gentry_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E1).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg Γ p T Φ y Φ0 E1 R HΓ Hl Hp Hd.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) as Hv.
  pose proof (loc_closed _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) as [_ HcΦ].
  pose proof (body_closed_prefix _ _ _ _ HcΦ Hp) as HcE; cbn in HcE; destruct HcE as [_ HcE].
  destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hl) as [_ HvΦ].
  pose proof (gm_valid_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HvΦ Hp) as HE0.
  intros pv U HE.
  destruct E1 as [ | pv' [Ta [sm Φy | E']] | | pvd Ad Md Ud | ]; cbn [ge_read] in HE;
    destruct HE as [HE | (A0 & M0 & HE)]; try discriminate; try (destruct sm; discriminate).
  - destruct HcE as (-> & _ & HcΦy); injection HE as <- <-; cbn.
    split; [ reflexivity | exact (body_closed_noopen _ _ HcΦy) ].
  - injection HE as <- <-; cbn.
    cbn [ge_valid syn_V] in HE0; destruct HE0 as (HEw & HΔ & _).
    rewrite gunit_scoped_mk in HcE; destruct HcE as [HsΔ _].
    exact (modexp_tele_weaken _ _ _ _ _ _ HEw (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ HΓ)).
  - (* a definition with a module part: its module part, an alias *)
    injection HE as <- <- <- <-.
    cbn [ge_read] in Hd; inversion Hd; subst; cbn.
    cbn [ge_valid syn_V] in HE0; destruct HE0 as [(HEw & HΔ & _) _].
    destruct HcE as (_ & _ & HsU); rewrite gunit_scoped_mk in HsU; destruct HsU as [HsΔ _].
    exact (modexp_tele_weaken _ _ _ _ _ _ HEw (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ HΓ)).
Qed.

Lemma mdenote_unseal_all : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    (forall Γ H R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> modexp_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ H ->
       exists R', mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ H R' /\ mdesc_unsealed R R') /\
    (forall Γ o U R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ o U R -> gunit_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ o U ->
       exists R', udenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ o (unit_at o U) R' /\ mdesc_unsealed R R') /\
    (forall Γ o E R, edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E R -> gentry_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ o E ->
       exists R', edenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ o (entry_at o E) R' /\ mdesc_unsealed R R') /\
    (forall Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> body_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> body_xp (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ Φ Φx) /\
    (forall Γ H its gs, items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H ->
       items_gen (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ H its gs).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg; pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) as Hv; pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc; apply mdenote_all_ind.
  - (* a loaded unit or an open frame: its stored body, unsealed *)
    intros Γ H p T Φ Hq Hu _.
    exists (mdesc_closed nil p T (gm_unseal Φ) nil); split; [| constructor ].
    eapply mdenote_unit; [ exact Hq | rewrite gc_unit_unseal, Hu; reflexivity ].
  - (* the open frame of a member's module: its type former, with its
       module unsealed *)
    intros Γ H p pq k D Mk Tm Φm Hq Hk HMk Hl _.
    exists (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil p Tm (gm_unseal Φm) nil)); split;
      [ eapply mdenote_ind_frame; [ exact Hq | rewrite gs_find_ind_unseal; exact Hk | exact HMk
                             | rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity ]
      | constructor; [ exact I | constructor ] ].
  - (* a slot *)
    intros Γ x U R Hx Hu IHu Hw.
    destruct Hw as [HH | (? & ? & [=] & _)].
    pose proof (ctx_lookup_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) Hx) as HU.
    destruct (IHu (gunit_unseal_precondition_full _ _ _ _ (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)))) as (R' & Hu' & Hd).
    exists R'; split; [ eapply mdenote_slot; eassumption | exact Hd ].
  - (* a literal *)
    intros Γ U R Hu IHu Hw.
    destruct Hw as [HH | (? & ? & [=] & _)].
    destruct (IHu (gunit_unseal_precondition_full _ _ _ _ (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HH)))) as (R' & Hu' & Hd).
    exists R'; split; [ apply mdenote_lit; exact Hu' | exact Hd ].
  - (* an application of a module *)
    intros Γ H N R R' Hm IH Ha Hw.
    destruct Hw as [HH | (? & ? & [=] & _)].
    destruct (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HH)) as (HH0 & R1 & T & B & T1 & i & Hm1 & Ht & Hv1 & HB & HN); cbn [gen_m] in *.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm1 _ Hm) in Ht.
    destruct (IH (or_introl HH0)) as (R0' & Hm' & Hd).
    assert (Hn : forall r A om, R <> mdesc_term r A om) by (intros r A om ->; discriminate Ht).
    destruct (mdesc_unsealed_at _ _ _ _ Hd Hn Ha) as (R1' & Ha' & Hd1 & _).
    exists R1'; split; [ eapply mdenote_app; eassumption | exact Hd1 ].
  - (* a selection *)
    intros Γ H y R0 R0m Γy E rd R R' Hm IH Hmod He Hd IHd Hr Hw.
    assert (HH0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H)
      by (destruct Hw as [HH | (H0 & x & [= <- <-] & HH)]; [ exact (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HH)) | exact HH ]).
    destruct (IH (or_introl HH0)) as (R0' & Hm' & Hd0).
    destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd0 Hmod) as (R0m' & Hmod' & Hdm).
    pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HH0 Hm) Hmod) as Hok0.
    destruct Hdm as [ r A om om' | Δ Φw Φ | Θc p T Φ Ns | ].
    1,4: exfalso; exact (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmod).
    + (* an open module: its entry, read as it is *)
      inversion Hok0 as [| ? ? ? ? ? HC _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ | |]; subst.
      cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ' x E1 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
      destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- -> <-] & _).
      assert (He1 : Γy = body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ /\ rd = reader_open Δ Φ' /\ E1 = E).
      { destruct E1 as [[|] ? ? ? [] | | | | ]; try discriminate; injection He as <- <- <-; repeat split. }
      destruct He1 as (-> & -> & HE1).
      assert (Hep : gentry_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ ((body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ) ++ Γ) None E).
      { intros pv U HEU; rewrite HE1 in Hp.
        assert (Hu : entry_unit E = Some U) by (destruct HEU as [-> | (? & ? & ->)]; reflexivity).
        pose proof (body_prefix_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hp Hu) as HU.
        rewrite <- app_assoc; apply gunit_unseal_precondition_full, (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)). }
      destruct (IHd Hep) as (R'' & Hd'' & HdR).
      cbn in Hr; destruct (gm_fill Φ') as [σ |] eqn:Hf; cbn in Hr; [ injection Hr as <- | discriminate ].
      exists (mdesc_up Δ (mdesc_sub R'' σ)); split; [| apply mdesc_unsealed_up, mdesc_unsealed_sub; exact HdR ].
      eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm' | exact Hmod' | cbn; rewrite Hp; exact He | exact Hd'' | cbn; rewrite Hf; reflexivity ].
    + (* a closed module: its stored entry, unsealed *)
      pose proof (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hm) Hmod) as Hl; cbn in Hl.
      pose proof (loc_closed _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) as [_ HcΦ].
      inversion Hok0 as [| | Γ0 Θa T0 Φ1 Ns1 Θ0 Ξ0 p0 lp Hg0 Hsub Hloc HaT HsT' HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ |]; subst.
      cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ0 x E1 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
      injection He as <- <- <-.
      destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- -> <-] & _).
      pose proof (body_closed_prefix _ _ _ _ HcΦ Hp) as HcE; cbn in HcE; destruct HcE as [_ HcE].
      destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hl) as [_ HvΦ].
      pose proof (gm_valid_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HvΦ Hp) as HE0.
      assert (Hep : gentry_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ (nil ++ Γ) (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E1))
        by exact (closed_entry_unseal_precondition _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΘ') Hl Hp Hd).
      destruct (IHd Hep) as (R'' & Hd'' & HdR).
      cbn in Hr; destruct (mdesc_ats_read R Ns) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn in Hr; [ injection Hr as <- | discriminate ].
      assert (Hats' : exists R1', mdesc_ats_read R'' Ns = Some R1' /\ mdesc_unsealed R1 R1').
      { destruct HdR as [r A om om' | | | Θd Ad Md Rm Rm'' Hmm HdRm];
          try (cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats |- *; eapply mdesc_unsealed_ats; [ constructor | discriminate | exact Hats ]).
        2: { (* a definition with a module part: its module part at the
                arguments, and its term part given them when it has no
                outside parameter *)
             assert (Hnm : forall r0 A0 om, Rm <> mdesc_term r0 A0 om) by (intros r0 A0 om ->; exact Hmm).
             destruct Θd as [| e Θd].
             - cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats |- *.
               destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term ak_relevant Ad (Some Md)) Ns) as [[? B [M' |] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
               destruct (mdesc_ats Rm Ns) as [Rm1 |] eqn:E; [ injection Hats as <- | discriminate ].
               destruct (mdesc_unsealed_ats _ _ _ _ HdRm Hnm E) as (Rm1' & -> & Hd1).
               eexists; split; [ reflexivity | constructor; [ exact (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm E) | exact Hd1 ] ].
             - cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats |- *; eapply mdesc_unsealed_ats; [ constructor; eassumption | discriminate | exact Hats ]. }
        cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats |- *.
        (* a stored definition: unsealed, an abstract one with a body gains it *)
        destruct (edenote_term_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hd) as (b & pv & oM & HE1 & Hom).
        pose proof (ge_read_def _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE1) as ->.
        cbn [entry_at mdesc_entry_path ge_unseal ge_read] in Hd''; inversion Hd''; subst.
        destruct oM as [M |].
        - destruct b; cbn in *.
          + exists R1; split; [ exact Hats | destruct (mdesc_ats_term _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (? & ? & ->); constructor ].
          + cbn [ge_valid syn_V] in HE0; destruct HE0 as (A1 & -> & _ & HM).
            destruct (HM M eq_refl) as (M1 & -> & _).
            exact (ats_term_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ HaT (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) Hats).
        - assert (Hn : (if b then None else None) = @None exp) by (destruct b; reflexivity).
          destruct b; cbn in *; (exists R1; split; [ exact Hats | destruct (mdesc_ats_term _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (? & ? & ->); constructor ]). }
      destruct Hats' as (R1' & Hats' & Hd1).
      exists (mdesc_up Θc (mdesc_named Θc Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R1')); split; [| apply mdesc_unsealed_up, mdesc_unsealed_named; exact Hd1 ].
      eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm' | exact Hmod' | cbn; rewrite gm_prefix_upto_unseal, Hp; cbn; reflexivity
                     | cbn [mdesc_entry_path entry_at] in Hd'' |- *; rewrite <- ge_read_unseal in Hd''; exact Hd'' | cbn; rewrite Hats'; reflexivity ].
  - (* the open frame of a record's module: its type former, with its
       module unsealed *)
    intros Γ H p R Tm Φm Hq Hr Hl _.
    exists (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil p Tm (gm_unseal Φm) nil)); split;
      [ eapply mdenote_record_frame; [ exact Hq | rewrite gs_find_record_unseal; exact Hr
                                | rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity ]
      | constructor; [ exact I | constructor ] ].
  - (* a body: a stored one is closed, with no open *)
    intros Γ o Δ sm Φ Φx R Hx IHx Hb Hpre.
    destruct o as [pq |]; cbn in Hpre |- *.
    + destruct Hpre as [-> Hno].
      pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ (body_xp_noopen _ _ _ _ Hno)) as ->.
      cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <-.
      exists (mdesc_closed nil pq Δ (gm_unseal Φ) nil); split; [| constructor ].
      eapply udenote_body; [ apply body_xp_noopen, gm_noopen_unseal; exact Hno | reflexivity ].
    + exists R; split; [ eapply udenote_body; [ exact (IHx (Hpre _ Hx)) | exact Hb ] |].
      destruct sm; cbn in Hb; [ injection Hb as <-; constructor | discriminate ].
  - (* an alias *)
    intros Γ o Δ E R R' Hm IH Hmod Hpre.
    destruct (IH (or_introl Hpre)) as (R1 & Hm1 & Hd).
    destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd Hmod) as (Rm' & Hmod' & Hdm).
    exists (mdesc_up Δ Rm'); split; [| apply mdesc_unsealed_up; exact Hdm ].
    destruct o; cbn; eapply udenote_alias; eassumption.
  - (* a definition: a stored one may gain its δ-reduct *)
    intros Γ o b pv r A oM _.
    destruct o; cbn [entry_at ge_unseal].
    + eexists; split; constructor.
    + eexists; split; constructor.
  - intros Γ o pv U R Hu IHu Hpre.
    destruct (IHu (Hpre _ _ (or_introl eq_refl))) as (R' & Hu' & Hd).
    exists R'; split; [| exact Hd ].
    destruct o; cbn [entry_at]; [| constructor; exact Hu' ].
    destruct U as [Δ [sm Φ | E]]; cbn in Hu' |- *; constructor; exact Hu'.
  - (* a stored inductive type: its type former, with its module unsealed *)
    intros Γ o pv pq k D Φ Mk pm Tm Φm HMk Hpm Hl _.
    exists (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm (gm_unseal Φm) nil)); split.
    + destruct o; cbn [entry_at ge_unseal];
        (eapply edenote_ind_case; [ exact HMk | exact Hpm | rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity ]).
    + constructor; [ exact I | constructor ].
  - (* a definition with a module part: its module part, read unsealed *)
    intros Γ o pv A M Δ E Rm Hu IHu Hpre.
    destruct (IHu (Hpre _ _ (or_intror (ex_intro _ A (ex_intro _ M eq_refl))))) as (Rm' & Hu' & Hd).
    exists (mdesc_dm nil A M Rm'); split.
    + destruct o; cbn [entry_at ge_unseal unit_at gu_unseal] in Hu' |- *; constructor; exact Hu'.
    + constructor; [ exact (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu) | exact Hd ].
  - (* a stored record type: its type former, with its module unsealed *)
    intros Γ p pv pr R Φ Tm Φm Hl _.
    exists (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil p Tm (gm_unseal Φm) nil)); split;
      [ cbn [entry_at ge_unseal]; eapply edenote_record; rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity
      | constructor; [ exact I | constructor ] ].
  - intros; constructor.
  - intros Γ Φ Φx x E Hx IHx Hpre; constructor; apply IHx; intros k Ψ H Hk; apply (Hpre k); exact Hk.
  - (* an open: what it generates is read alike *)
    intros Γ Φ Φx H its Φg R Rm gs Hx IHx Hm IHm Hmod Hig IHig Hok HΦg Hpre.
    unfold body_unseal_precondition in Hpre; rewrite (body_opens_open _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hig) in Hpre.
    pose proof (Hpre 0 _ _ eq_refl) as HH.
    destruct (IHm (or_introl HH)) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
    destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd Hmod) as (Rm' & Hmod' & _).
    econstructor; [ apply IHx; intros k Ψ H' Hk; exact (Hpre (S k) _ _ Hk) | exact Hm' | exact Hmod' | exact (IHig HH) | exact Hok
                  | exact HΦg ].
  - intros; constructor.
  - intros Γ H d pv its gs Hig IHig HH; constructor; exact (IHig HH).
  - intros Γ H n d pv ra A om its gs Hm IHm Hig IHig HH.
    destruct (IHm (or_intror (ex_intro _ H (ex_intro _ n (conj eq_refl HH))))) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
    inversion Hd; subst; econstructor; [ exact Hm' | exact (IHig HH) ].
  - intros Γ H n d pv R its gs Hm IHm Hism Hig IHig HH.
    destruct (IHm (or_intror (ex_intro _ H (ex_intro _ n (conj eq_refl HH))))) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
    econstructor; [ exact Hm' | exact (mdesc_unsealed_is_mod _ _ Hd Hism) | exact (IHig HH) ].
  - (* a member with a term part and a module part *)
    intros Γ H n d pv R A Rm its gs Hm IHm Hty Hmd Hig IHig HH.
    destruct (IHm (or_intror (ex_intro _ H (ex_intro _ n (conj eq_refl HH))))) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
    destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd Hmd) as (Rm' & Hmd' & _).
    eapply items_gen_dm; [ exact Hm' | rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_ty _ _ Hd); exact Hty | exact Hmd' | exact (IHig HH) ].
Qed.

Corollary mdenote_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H' R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R ->
    exists R', mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ H R' /\ mdesc_unsealed R R'.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  exact (proj1 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm (or_introl (wf_modexp_eq_refl_left HH))).
Qed.

Corollary mdenote_mem_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H' x R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R ->
    exists R', mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ (me_mem H x) R' /\ mdesc_unsealed R R'.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  exact (proj1 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm (or_intror (ex_intro _ H (ex_intro _ x (conj eq_refl (wf_modexp_eq_refl_left HH)))))).
Qed.

A description read unsealed reads an open frame only if it did: unsealing keeps the paths of closed module parts, and the frames.
Lemma desc_reads_frame_unseal : forall Ξ R R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> desc_reads_frame (gs_unseal Ξ) R' -> desc_reads_frame Ξ R.
Proof.
  intros Ξ R R' Hd; induction Hd; intros (Θ1 & p1 & T1 & Φ1 & Ns1 & Hm & Hf); cbn in Hm; try discriminate.
  - injection Hm as <- <- <- _ <-; exists Θ, p, T, Φ, Ns; split; [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite gc_frame_unseal in Hf; destruct (gc_frame Ξ p); [ discriminate | contradiction ].
  - exact (IHHd (ex_intro _ Θ1 (ex_intro _ p1 (ex_intro _ T1 (ex_intro _ Φ1 (ex_intro _ Ns1 (conj Hm Hf))))))).
Qed.

A target that is no module still being defined is none unsealed.
Corollary frame_free_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ E E', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E' -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ Γ E ->
    frame_free_target (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ E.
Proof.
  intros * HE (R & Hm & Hn).
  destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hm) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
  exists R'; split; [ exact Hm' | intros Hr; exact (Hn (desc_reads_frame_unseal _ _ _ Hd Hr)) ].
Qed.

Corollary body_xp_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> body_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    body_xp (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ Φ Φx.
Proof. intros * Hg; exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _). Qed.

A member read from a closed module part as a term part with a module part, a type former's or a definition's: its term part as it is, its module part unsealed.
#[local] Ltac unseal_dm_read :=
  match goal with
  | HH : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵐ ?H ≈ ?H, Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H _) _, Hed : edenote _ _ _ _ _ _,
    Hats : mdesc_ats_read _ ?Ns = Some _, Hr : mdesc_reduct _ = Some _ |- _ =>
      left; destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm) as (R' & Hm' & Hd);
      cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst;
      unfold ind_former_desc, record_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats;
      match type of Hats with context [mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term ?r0 ?A0 (Some ?M0)) Ns] =>
        destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term r0 A0 (Some M0)) Ns) as [[? B [M' |] | | |] |]; try discriminate end;
      match type of Hats with context [mdesc_ats ?Rm0 Ns] =>
        destruct (mdesc_ats Rm0 Ns) as [Rm1 |]; [ injection Hats as <- | discriminate ] end;
      rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Hd, Hr by reflexivity; cbn [mdesc_up List.app] in Hd, Hr;
      inversion Hd; subst; eexists; split; [ exact Hm' | split; [ exact Hr | rewrite mdesc_named_fix by reflexivity; reflexivity ] ]
  end.

The δ-reduct a member is looked up with, unsealed: the same, or, for a stored axiom or abstract definition, read as its name, the name of a member of the closed module part the module expression has unsealed.
Lemma mem_unseal_red : forall Θ Ξ Γ H x R M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_reduct R = Some M ->
    (exists R', mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ (me_mem H x) R' /\ mdesc_reduct R' = Some M /\ mdesc_type R' = mdesc_type R) \/
    (exists RH' Θ' p T Φ Ns, mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ H RH' /\
       mdesc_mod RH' = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) /\ M = ctx_fn Θ' (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns)).
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm Hr.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  inversion Hm as [? ? ? ? ? Hq Hu | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk HMk Hl | | | | ? ? ? R0 R0m Γy E rd Re ? Hm0 Hmd He Hed Hrd
                  | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk Hl]; subst.
  { cbn in Hr; discriminate. }
  { (* the open frame of a member's module: its type former, its term part
       as it is *)
    left; eexists; split;
      [ eapply mdenote_ind_frame; [ exact Hq | rewrite gs_find_ind_unseal; exact Hk | exact HMk
                             | rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity ]
      | split; [ exact Hr | reflexivity ] ]. }
  2: { (* the open frame of a record's module: likewise *)
    left; eexists; split;
      [ eapply mdenote_record_frame; [ exact Hq | rewrite gs_find_record_unseal; exact Hk
                                | rewrite gc_loc_unseal, Hl; reflexivity ]
      | split; [ exact Hr | reflexivity ] ]. }
  destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) as (R0' & Hm0' & Hd0).
  destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd0 Hmd) as (R0m' & Hmd' & Hdm).
  destruct Hdm as [r0 A0 om om' | Δ Φw Φ | Θc p T Φ Ns | ].
  1,4: exfalso; exact (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd).
  - (* an open module part: read alike *)
    left.
    cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ x) as [[| Φ' y E1 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
    destruct E1 as [[|] pv r1 A [M0 |] | pv U | | pv Ad Md Ud | ]; try discriminate; injection He as <- <- <-.
    + exists R; split; [| split; [ exact Hr | reflexivity ] ].
      inversion Hed; subst.
      eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm0' | exact Hmd' | cbn; rewrite Hp; reflexivity | constructor | exact Hrd ].
    + exfalso; cbn in Hrd.
      destruct (gm_fill Φ') as [σ |]; cbn in Hrd; [ injection Hrd as <- | discriminate ].
      inversion Hed; subst.
      match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => pose proof (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as Hmm end.
      destruct Re; cbn in Hmm, Hr; try contradiction; discriminate.
    + (* a definition with a module part: its term part as it is, its
         module part, an alias, read unsealed *)
      pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) Hmd) as Hok0.
      inversion Hok0 as [| ? ? ? ? ? HC _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ | |]; subst.
      destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- <- <-] & _).
      pose proof (body_prefix_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hp eq_refl) as HU.
      inversion Hed; subst.
      match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ _ Hu) as (Rm' & Hu' & _) end;
        [ rewrite <- app_assoc; apply gunit_unseal_precondition_full, (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) |].
      cbn in Hrd; destruct (gm_fill Φ') as [σ |] eqn:Hf; cbn in Hrd; [ injection Hrd as <- | discriminate ].
      eexists; split.
      * eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm0' | exact Hmd' | cbn; rewrite Hp; reflexivity | constructor; exact Hu'
                       | cbn; rewrite Hf; reflexivity ].
      * split; [ exact Hr | reflexivity ].
  - (* a closed module part: its stored entry, unsealed *)
    cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ x) as [[| Φ0 y E0 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
    injection He as <- <- <-.
    destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- <- <-] & _).
    cbn in Hrd; destruct (mdesc_ats_read Re Ns) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn in Hrd; [ injection Hrd as <- | discriminate ].
    assert (Hsame : edenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) (nil ++ Γ) (mdesc_entry_path (mdesc_closed Θc p T (gm_unseal Φ) Ns) y)
                      (ge_read T (ge_unseal E0)) Re ->
                    exists R', mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ (me_mem H y) R' /\ mdesc_reduct R' = Some M /\
                      mdesc_type R' = mdesc_type (mdesc_up Θc (mdesc_named Θc Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R1))).
    { intros Hed'; eexists; split; [| split; [ exact Hr | reflexivity ] ].
      assert (He' : mdesc_entry (mdesc_closed Θc p T (gm_unseal Φ) Ns) y = Some (nil, ge_read T (ge_unseal E0), reader_closed Θc Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns)))
        by (unfold mdesc_entry; rewrite gm_prefix_upto_unseal, Hp; reflexivity).
      eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm0' | exact Hmd' | exact He' | exact Hed' | cbn; rewrite Hats; reflexivity ]. }
    assert (Hnone : forall Ns0 r1 A1 R2, mdesc_ats (mdesc_term r1 A1 None) Ns0 = Some R2 -> exists A2, R2 = mdesc_term r1 A2 None).
    { induction Ns0 as [| N0 Ns0 IHN]; intros * Ha0; cbn in Ha0; [ injection Ha0 as <-; eauto |].
      destruct (pi_view A1) as [[? ?] |]; [ exact (IHN _ _ _ Ha0) | discriminate ]. }
    destruct E0 as [b pv r1 A [M0 |] | pv [Δ [sm Φy | E']] | pv pq D ΦD | pv Ad Md Ud | pr Rr Φr ].
    + destruct b.
      * left; apply Hsame; cbn in Hed |- *; inversion Hed; subst; constructor.
      * (* abstract: read as its name *)
        right; exists R0', Θc, p, T, (gm_unseal Φ), Ns; split; [ exact Hm0' | split; [ exact Hmd' |] ].
        cbn in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
        destruct (Hnone _ _ _ _ Hats) as (A2 & ->).
        destruct (mdesc_named_term_none Θc Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) r1 A2) as [(Hn & _) | Hn];
          rewrite Hn in Hr; cbn in Hr; [ discriminate | injection Hr as <-; reflexivity ].
    + (* an axiom: read as its name *)
      right; exists R0', Θc, p, T, (gm_unseal Φ), Ns; split; [ exact Hm0' | split; [ exact Hmd' |] ].
      cbn in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
      assert (Hn0 : (if b then @None exp else None) = None) by (destruct b; reflexivity); rewrite Hn0 in Hats.
      destruct (Hnone _ _ _ _ Hats) as (A2 & ->).
      destruct (mdesc_named_term_none Θc Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) r1 A2) as [(Hn & _) | Hn];
        rewrite Hn in Hr; cbn in Hr; [ discriminate | injection Hr as <-; reflexivity ].
    + exfalso; assert (Hmm : mdesc_is_mod Re) by (destruct sm; cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; eapply udenote_is_mod; eassumption).
      rewrite mdesc_ats_read_mod in Hats by exact Hmm.
      pose proof (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm Hats) as Hm1; destruct R1; cbn in Hm1; try contradiction;
        rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Hr by reflexivity; cbn in Hr; discriminate.
    + exfalso; assert (Hmm : mdesc_is_mod Re) by (cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; eapply udenote_is_mod; eassumption).
      rewrite mdesc_ats_read_mod in Hats by exact Hmm.
      pose proof (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm Hats) as Hm1; destruct R1; cbn in Hm1; try contradiction;
        rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Hr by reflexivity; cbn in Hr; discriminate.
    (* a type former, or a definition with a module part: its term part,
       as it is, and its module part read unsealed *)
    + unseal_dm_read.
    + unseal_dm_read.
    + unseal_dm_read.
Qed.

The rank of a group's views does not see seals.
Lemma view_rank_ok_unseal : forall Θ Ξ D rk, view_rank_ok Θ Ξ D rk -> view_rank_ok (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) D rk.
Proof.
  intros * [Hr0 Hr1 Hr2]; constructor; [ exact Hr0 | | exact Hr2 ].
  intros * Hk Hh Hl; rewrite ind_lookup_unseal in Hl; eapply Hr1; eassumption.
Qed.

Nor does the agreement of its views' maps.
Lemma view_maps_coherent_unseal : forall Θ Ξ D, view_maps_coherent Θ Ξ D -> view_maps_coherent (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) D.
Proof. unfold view_maps_coherent; intros * Hc * Hk Hh Hl; rewrite ind_lookup_unseal in Hl; eapply Hc; eassumption. Qed.

Nor do the facts about its record views without a judgment.
Lemma rview_struct_ok_unseal : forall Θ Ξ D, rview_struct_ok Θ Ξ D -> rview_struct_ok (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) D.
Proof.
  intros * [Hr Hn Hc Hrel Hsu Ho]; constructor; try assumption.
  - intros * Hk Hh; destruct (Hr _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) as [R [Hl Hnm Hct Has Hnd]]; exists R; constructor; try assumption.
    rewrite record_lookup_unseal; exact Hl.
  - intros * Hk Hh Hl; rewrite record_lookup_unseal in Hl; exact (Hrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh Hl).
Qed.

Unsealing Preserves Every Judgment

Descriptions With No Member of a Type of Levels, Unsealed

The member descriptions ⊢ⁿˡ reads are no terms, so they are read unsealed as mdesc_unseal_struct gives them.
The unit of a module entry of an expanded body, in a well-formed extension, denotes unsealed the unsealing of what it denotes.
Lemma open_entry_udenote_unseal : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Δ Φx y Φ0 E U R,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ++ Γ -> gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
    udenote Θ Ξ (body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ) None U R ->
    udenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) (body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ) None U (mdesc_unseal_struct R) /\
    mdesc_unsealed R (mdesc_unseal_struct R).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * HC Hp HU Hu.
  pose proof (body_prefix_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hp HU) as HUw.
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ _ Hu
              (gunit_unseal_precondition_full _ _ _ _ (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HUw)))) as (R' & Hu' & Hd).
  rewrite <- (mdesc_unsealed_struct_of_non_term _ _ Hd); [ split; [ exact Hu' | exact Hd ] |].
  intros r A om ->; exact (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu).
Qed.

A stored entry of a filed body, no definition, read as it is stored, denotes unsealed the unsealing of what it denotes.
Lemma closed_entry_edenote_unseal : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ y Φ0 E R,
    gc_body Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) ->
    (forall b pv r A oM, E <> ge_def b pv r A oM) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ ⋅ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E) R ->
    edenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) ⋅ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T (ge_unseal E)) (mdesc_unseal_struct R) /\
    mdesc_unsealed R (mdesc_unseal_struct R).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hb Hp Hn Hd.
  assert (HΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅) by (apply wf_ctx_empty; exact Hg).
  pose proof (closed_entry_unseal_precondition _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΓ (or_intror Hb) Hp Hd) as Hpre.
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg))) _ _ _ _ Hd Hpre) as (R' & Hd' & Hu).
  cbn [entry_at] in Hd'; rewrite <- ge_read_unseal in Hd'.
  rewrite <- (mdesc_unsealed_struct_of_non_term _ _ Hu); [ split; [ exact Hd' | exact Hu ] |].
  intros r A om ->; destruct (edenote_term_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hd) as (b & pv & oM & HE & _).
  exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ (ge_read_def _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE)).
Qed.

The description a flag premise names, chosen: when the flag is set the premises are vacuous and R0 serves.
Lemma flag_desc_choice : forall (lv : bool) (R0 : mdesc) (P Q : mdesc -> Prop),
    (lv = false -> exists R, P R /\ Q R) -> exists R, (lv = false -> P R) /\ (lv = false -> Q R).
Proof.
  intros [|] R0 P Q H; [ exists R0; split; discriminate |].
  destruct (H eq_refl) as (R & HP & HQ); exists R; split; intros _; assumption.
Qed.

The cases of ⊢ⁿˡ unsealed, from the induction hypotheses of its premises, as the mutual induction gives them.
A term: of the same kind.
Lemma no_level_term_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ r A om, r <> ak_level ->
    forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_term r A om) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R'.
Proof.
  intros * Hr R' Hd; inversion Hd; subst; apply wf_no_level_term; exact Hr.
Qed.

An open body module: unchanged, its module entries denoting unsealed the unsealings of their descriptions.
Lemma no_level_open_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Φw Φx member_descs,
    gm_noopen Φx ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ≈ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ->
    gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ≈ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) -> entry_kind E <> ak_level) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
       udenote Θ Ξ (body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ) None U (member_descs y)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ member_descs y /\
       forall R', mdesc_unsealed (member_descs y) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R') ->
    forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_open Δ Φw Φx) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R'.
Proof.
  intros * Hno HX HXu Hnl Hu IH R' Hd; inversion Hd; subst.
  assert (Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) by exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_ext_eq_ctx HX)).
  assert (HC : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ++ Γ) by (rewrite app_assoc; exact (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HX)).
  eapply wf_no_level_open with (member_descs := fun y => mdesc_unseal_struct (member_descs y));
    [ exact Hno | exact HXu | exact Hnl
    | intros y Φ0 E U Hp HU; exact (proj1 (open_entry_udenote_unseal _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hp HU (Hu _ _ _ _ Hp HU)))
    | intros y Φ0 E U Hp HU; apply (proj2 (IH _ _ _ _ Hp HU));
      exact (proj2 (open_entry_udenote_unseal _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hp HU (Hu _ _ _ _ Hp HU))) ].
Qed.

A closed module: its stored body unsealed, whose entries are those stored, unsealed.
Lemma no_level_closed_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns member_descs,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ->
    gc_body Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    (forall y Φ0 b pv r A oM, gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv r A oM)) -> r <> ak_level) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E, gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> (forall b pv r A oM, E <> ge_def b pv r A oM) ->
       edenote Θ Ξ ⋅ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E) (member_descs y)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E, gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> (forall b pv r A oM, E <> ge_def b pv r A oM) ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ⁿˡ member_descs y /\
       forall R', mdesc_unsealed (member_descs y) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ⁿˡ R') ->
    forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R'.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hgu Hb Hnl Hed IH R' Hd; inversion Hd; subst.
  assert (Hpre : forall y Φ0' E', gm_prefix_upto (gm_unseal Φ) y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') ->
            exists Φ0 E, gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) /\ E' = ge_unseal E).
  { intros y Φ0' E' Hp'; rewrite gm_prefix_upto_unseal in Hp'.
    destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [Φy |] eqn:Hp; cbn in Hp'; [| discriminate ].
    destruct Φy as [| Φ0 x E | ? ? ?]; cbn in Hp'; try discriminate.
    injection Hp' as <- <- <-; exists Φ0, E; split; reflexivity. }
  assert (Hnd : forall E, (forall b pv r A oM, ge_unseal E <> ge_def b pv r A oM) -> forall b pv r A oM, E <> ge_def b pv r A oM)
    by (intros E HnE b pv r A oM ->; exact (HnE _ _ _ _ _ eq_refl)).
  assert (Hdu : forall E b pv r A oM, ge_unseal E = ge_def b pv r A oM -> exists b0 oM0, E = ge_def b0 pv r A oM0).
  { intros [b0 pv0 r0 A0 oM0 | ? [? [? ? | ?]] | | | ] * HE; cbn in HE; try discriminate.
    injection HE as _ <- <- <- _; eexists; eexists; reflexivity. }
  eapply wf_no_level_closed with (member_descs := fun y => mdesc_unseal_struct (member_descs y)).
  - exact Hgu.
  - rewrite gc_body_unseal, Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros y Φ0' b pv r A oM Hp'; destruct (Hpre _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & HE).
    destruct (Hdu _ _ _ _ _ _ (eq_sym HE)) as (b0 & oM0 & ->); exact (Hnl _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp).
  - intros y Φ0' E' Hp' HnE'; destruct (Hpre _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & ->).
    pose proof (Hnd _ HnE') as HnE.
    exact (proj1 (closed_entry_edenote_unseal _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb Hp HnE (Hed _ _ _ Hp HnE))).
  - intros y Φ0' E' Hp' HnE'; destruct (Hpre _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & ->).
    pose proof (Hnd _ HnE') as HnE.
    apply (proj2 (IH _ _ _ Hp HnE)).
    exact (proj2 (closed_entry_edenote_unseal _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb Hp HnE (Hed _ _ _ Hp HnE))).
Qed.

A definition with a module part: its module part, unsealed.
Lemma no_level_dm_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ Θd A M Rm,
    (forall Rm', mdesc_mod Rm = Some Rm' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rm' /\
       forall R', mdesc_unsealed Rm' R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R') ->
    forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm) R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R'.
Proof.
  intros * IH R' Hd; inversion Hd as [| | | ? ? ? ? Rm2 Hm Hu]; subst.
  apply wf_no_level_dm; intros Rm3 Hmod.
  rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_unsealed_is_mod _ _ Hu Hm)) in Hmod; injection Hmod as <-.
  exact (proj2 (IH _ (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ Hm)) _ Hu).
Qed.

The flag premises of a unit rule over a module expression, unsealed: what it denotes, unsealed, has no member of a type of levels.
Lemma modexp_flag_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ E E' (lv : bool) Rt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E' ->
    (lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ E Rt) ->
    (lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt /\ forall R', mdesc_unsealed Rt R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R') ->
    exists Rt', (lv = false -> mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ E Rt') /\
           (lv = false -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt').
Proof.
  intros * HE Hm IH; apply (flag_desc_choice lv Rt); intros Hlv.
  destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ HE (Hm Hlv)) as (R' & Hm' & Hd).
  exists R'; split; [ exact Hm' | exact (proj2 (IH Hlv) _ Hd) ].
Qed.

The same over the literal of a body under no parameter, whose opens are well-formed module expressions.
Lemma body_flag_unseal : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx (lv : bool) Rt,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> body_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    (lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) Rt) ->
    (lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt /\ forall R', mdesc_unsealed Rt R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R') ->
    exists Rt', (lv = false -> mdenote (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ) Γ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) Rt') /\
           (lv = false -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt').
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hx Ho Hm IH; apply (flag_desc_choice lv Rt); intros Hlv.
  assert (Hu : udenote Θ Ξ Γ None (gu_open nil Φ) Rt) by (pose proof (Hm Hlv) as Hl; inversion Hl; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate); assumption).
  assert (Hpre : gunit_unseal_precondition Θ Ξ Γ None (gu_open nil Φ)).
  { cbn; intros Φx' Hx'.
    rewrite <- (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ Hx'); exact Ho. }
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_unseal_all _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ _ Hu Hpre) as (R' & Hu' & Hd).
  exists R'; split; [ apply mdenote_lit; exact Hu' | exact (proj2 (IH Hlv) _ Hd) ].
Qed.

A premise of a rule, from the hypotheses; an assumption is chosen backtracking, since a premise typing a term the conclusion does not mention (the domain of an application) may match several.
Ltac seal_premise :=
  multimatch goal with
  | H : _ |- _ => exact H
  | _ => solve [ intros; eapply proj1; eauto ]
  | _ => solve [ eauto ]
  end.
The parameters of a module before its first entry are types of a universe in the frames X unsealed: their frames' parameters are X's.
Ltac unseal_params X :=
  let E := fresh "E" in
  assert (E : gs_tele (gs_unseal X) = gs_tele X) by exact (gs_tele_unseal X);
  cbn [gs_unseal] in E; intros; rewrite E; eapply proj2; eauto.
A target that is no module still being defined is none unsealed (frame_free_unseal), read off the target's typing.
Ltac frame_free_premise_unseal :=
  match goal with
  | |- frame_free_target (gds_unseal _) (gs_unseal _) _ _ =>
      rewrite ?gs_tele_unseal; eapply frame_free_unseal;
      [ first [ eassumption | eapply wf_me_sym; eassumption | eapply wf_me_lit; eassumption ] | eassumption ]
  | |- forall _ _ _, _ -> frame_free_target (gds_unseal _) (gs_unseal _) _ _ =>
      let Hk := fresh "Hk" in
      intros ? ? ? Hk; eapply frame_free_unseal; [ solve [ eapply proj1; eauto | eauto ] | eauto ]
  end.
Ltac unseal_premise :=
  first [ eassumption | solve [ frame_free_premise_unseal ] | solve [ intros; eapply proj2; eauto ]
        | solve [ eauto using gc_resolve_unseal_def, gc_resolve_unseal_transparent, gm_fresh_unseal, frame_fresh_unseal ] ].

Lemma unseal_preserves_wf_all :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ ⊢ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R /\ forall R', mdesc_unsealed R R' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_unseal E) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ /\ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ gm_unseal Φ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ /\ ⊢ᵍ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ).
Proof.
  apply wf_mut_ind_all; intros; destruct_conjs; split.
  (* the judgment itself *)
  all: try (solve [ econstructor; seal_premise ]).
  (* unsealed *)
  all: cbn.
  all: try rewrite <- (gs_tele_unseal Ξ).
  all: try rewrite <- (ind_lookup_unseal Θ Ξ) in *.
  all: try rewrite <- (record_lookup_unseal Θ Ξ) in *.
  all: try solve [ econstructor; rewrite ?gs_tele_unseal; unseal_premise ].
  (* a member: what it looks up, unsealed *)
  all: try match goal with
    | |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ a_mem ?H ?x : ?A =>
        match goal with Hs : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H, Hm : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) ?R, Ht : mdesc_type ?R = Some A |- _ =>
          let Hd := fresh "Hd" in
          destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hm) as (? & ? & Hd);
          eapply wf_mem_desc; [ eassumption | eassumption | rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_ty _ _ Hd); exact Ht ] end
    | |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ a_mem ?H ?x ≈ a_mem ?H' ?x : ?A =>
        match goal with Hs : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H', Hm : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) ?R, Ht : mdesc_type ?R = Some A,
                        Hm2 : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H' x) ?R2, Ht2 : mdesc_type ?R2 = Some _ |- _ =>
          let Hd := fresh "Hd" in let Hd2 := fresh "Hd" in
          destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hm) as (? & ? & Hd);
          destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right Hs) Hm2) as (? & ? & Hd2);
          eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_cong; [ eassumption | eassumption | rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_ty _ _ Hd); exact Ht
                                     | eassumption | rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_ty _ _ Hd2); exact Ht2 | eassumption ] end
    | |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ a_mem ?H ?x ≈ ?M : ?A =>
        match goal with Hs : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H, Hm : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) ?R, Ht : mdesc_type ?R = Some A,
                        Hr : mdesc_reduct ?R = Some M, Hsu : gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H |- _ =>
          destruct (mem_unseal_red _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hm Hr) as [(R' & Hm' & Hr' & Ht') | (RH' & Θ' & p & T & Φ & Ns & HmH' & Hmd' & ->)];
          [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hsu | exact Hm' | rewrite Ht'; exact Ht | exact Hr' ]
          | let Hd := fresh "Hd" in
            destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hm) as (? & ? & Hd);
            eapply mem_closed_part; [ exact Hsu | exact HmH' | exact Hmd' | eassumption | rewrite (mdesc_unsealed_ty _ _ Hd); exact Ht ] ] end
    end.
  (* a module member: the unit its module part stands for, unsealed *)
  all: try match goal with
    | Hs : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ me_mem ?H ?y ≈ me_mem ?H ?y, Hm : mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ (me_mem ?H ?y) ?R, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?R = Some ?Rm
      |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ me_mem ?H ?y ≈ mdesc_unit ?Rm =>
        let Hd := fresh "Hd" in let Hdm := fresh "Hdm" in
        destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hm) as (? & ? & Hd);
        destruct (mdesc_unsealed_mod _ _ _ Hd Hmd) as (? & ? & Hdm);
        rewrite <- (mdesc_unsealed_unit _ _ Hdm); eapply wf_me_delta_sel; eassumption
    end.
  (* a loaded unit or an open frame *)
  all: try match goal with
    | Hu : gc_unit ?Θ ?Ξ (me_unit ?fp) = Some _ |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵐ me_unit ?fp ≈ me_unit ?fp =>
        eapply wf_me_unit; [ eassumption | rewrite gc_unit_unseal, Hu; reflexivity ]
    end.
  (* a selection, an application: what they denote unsealed *)
  all: try match goal with
    | HH : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ ?H ≈ ?H', Hm : mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ (me_mem ?H ?y) ?R, Ht : mdesc_mod_tele ?R = Some _,
      Hm' : mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ (me_mem ?H' ?y) ?R', Ht' : mdesc_mod_tele ?R' = Some _
      |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ me_mem ?H ?y ≈ me_mem ?H' ?y =>
        destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm) as (? & ? & Hd1);
        destruct (mdenote_mem_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HH) Hm') as (? & ? & Hd2);
        eapply wf_me_mem; [ eassumption | eassumption | exact (mdesc_unsealed_mtele _ _ _ Hd1 Ht) | eassumption | exact (mdesc_unsealed_mtele _ _ _ Hd2 Ht') ]
    | HH : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ ?H ≈ ?H', Hm : mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?H ?R, Ht : mdesc_mod_tele ?R = Some _,
      Hm' : mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?H' ?R', Ht' : mdesc_mod_tele ?R' = Some _
      |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app ?H ?N ≈ me_app ?H' ?N' =>
        destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm) as (? & ? & Hd1);
        destruct (mdenote_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HH) Hm') as (? & ? & Hd2);
        eapply wf_me_app; [ eassumption | eassumption | exact (mdesc_unsealed_mtele _ _ _ Hd1 Ht) | eassumption | eassumption | eassumption
                          | eassumption | eassumption | eassumption | exact (mdesc_unsealed_mtele _ _ _ Hd2 Ht')
                          | eassumption | eassumption | eassumption | eassumption ]
    end.
  (* no member of a type of levels, unsealed *)
  all: try match goal with
    | |- forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_term _ _ _) R' -> _ => eapply no_level_term_unseal; eassumption
    | |- forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_open _ _ _) R' -> _ => eapply no_level_open_unseal; eassumption
    | |- forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_closed _ _ _ _ _) R' -> _ => eapply no_level_closed_unseal; eassumption
    | |- forall R', mdesc_unsealed (mdesc_dm _ _ _ _) R' -> _ => eapply no_level_dm_unseal; eassumption
    end.
  (* the flag premises of a unit rule: what is denoted, unsealed *)
  all: repeat match goal with
    | HE : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ ?G ⊢ᵐ ?E ≈ _, Hm : ?lv = false -> mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?G ?E ?Rt,
      IH : ?lv = false -> _ /\ (forall R', mdesc_unsealed ?Rt R' -> _) |- _ =>
        destruct (modexp_flag_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hm IH) as (? & ? & ?); clear Hm IH
    | HU : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ ?G ⊢ᵘ ?U ≈ _, Hm : ?lv = false -> mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?G (me_lit ?U) ?Rt,
      IH : ?lv = false -> _ /\ (forall R', mdesc_unsealed ?Rt R' -> _) |- _ =>
        destruct (modexp_flag_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(apply wf_me_lit; exact HU) Hm IH) as (? & ? & ?); clear Hm IH
    | Hx : body_xp ?Θ ?Ξ ?G ?Φ ?Φx,
      Ho : forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens ?Φ ?Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ ?G ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H,
      Hm : ?lv = false -> mdenote ?Θ ?Ξ ?G (me_lit (gu_open nil ?Φ)) ?Rt,
      IH : ?lv = false -> _ /\ (forall R', mdesc_unsealed ?Rt R' -> _), HX : ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ _ ⊢ˣ _ ≈ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (body_flag_unseal _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_ext_eq_ctx HX)) Hx Ho Hm IH) as (? & ? & ?);
        clear Hm IH
    end.
  all: try solve [ econstructor; rewrite ?gs_tele_unseal; unseal_premise ].
  (* a body: its expansion, unsealed *)
  all: try match goal with
    | Hx : body_xp ?Θ ?Ξ (?Δ ++ ?Γ) ?Φ ?Φx, Hx' : body_xp ?Θ ?Ξ (?Δ' ++ ?Γ) ?Φ' ?Φx',
      Ho : forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens ?Φ ?Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ ?Δ ++ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H,
      Ho' : forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens ?Φ' ?Φx') k = Some (Ψ, H) -> ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ ?Δ' ++ ?Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H
      |- gds_unseal ?Θ ⍮ gs_unseal ?Ξ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open ?Δ ?Φ ≈ gu_open ?Δ' ?Φ' =>
        let Hg := fresh "Hg" in
        assert (Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) by (eapply ctx_wf_gctx; eapply presup_ext_eq_ctx; eassumption);
        eapply wf_unit_eq_body;
          [ exact (body_xp_unseal _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hx Ho) | exact (body_xp_unseal _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hx' Ho') | unseal_premise .. ]
    end.
  (* a group: the containers of its views found unsealed alike *)
  all: try match goal with |- gds_unseal _ ⍮ gs_unseal _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ _ => idtac end.
  (* a member with its module: the module, unsealed, as any module is *)
  all: try match goal with
    | |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ ge_ind _ _ _ _ (gm_unseal _) =>
        eapply wf_gentry_ind_body; [ rewrite ?gs_tele_unseal; eassumption | eapply proj2; eauto ]
    | |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ ge_record _ _ _ (gm_unseal _) =>
        eapply wf_gentry_record_body; [ rewrite ?gs_tele_unseal; eassumption | eapply proj2; eauto ]
    end.
  (* the module of a record type, before its first entry *)
  all: try match goal with
    | |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_record _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄ =>
        match goal with
        | Hu : record_params _ = _ ++ gs_tele ?X, HE : gds_unseal _ ⍮ gs_unseal ?X ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ _,
          HC : ⊢ gds_unseal _ ⍮ gs_unseal ?X ⍮ _ |- _ =>
            rewrite <- (gs_tele_unseal X) in Hu, HC;
            eapply wf_gmod_record_nil; [ assumption | exact HC | eassumption | unseal_params X | exact HE | exact Hu ]
        end
    end.
  (* the module of a member, before its first entry *)
  all: try match goal with
    | |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_ind _ _ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄ =>
        match goal with
        | Hu : ind_uparams _ = _ ++ gs_tele ?X, HE : gds_unseal _ ⍮ gs_unseal ?X ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ _,
          HC : ⊢ gds_unseal _ ⍮ gs_unseal ?X ⍮ _ |- _ =>
            rewrite <- (gs_tele_unseal X) in Hu, HC;
            eapply wf_gmod_ind_nil; [ assumption | exact HC | eassumption | unseal_params X | exact HE | exact Hu ]
        end
    end.
  all: first [ eapply wf_gentry_ind_nil; try eassumption
             | match goal with He : gm_entry ?Φ0 (?y0 :: nil) = Some (ge_ind ?pv0 ?pq0 0 ?D0 ?Φm) |- _ =>
                 eapply wf_gentry_ind_mem_nil with (pv0 := pv0) (Φm := gm_unseal Φm);
                 try eassumption; try (rewrite gm_entry_unseal, He; reflexivity) end
             | eapply wf_gentry_def_mod; try eassumption ].
  all: try (match goal with Hrk : view_rank_ok _ _ _ ?rk |- exists rk, view_rank_ok _ _ _ rk =>
              exists rk; exact (view_rank_ok_unseal _ _ _ _ Hrk) end).
  all: try (match goal with Hvc : view_maps_coherent _ _ ?D |- view_maps_coherent _ _ ?D =>
              exact (view_maps_coherent_unseal _ _ _ Hvc) end).
  all: try (match goal with Hrs : rview_struct_ok _ _ ?D |- rview_struct_ok _ _ ?D =>
              exact (rview_struct_ok_unseal _ _ _ Hrs) end).
  all: try (match goal with Hq : ind_lookup ?Θ ((?mq, ?Kq, gu_body ?Δ ?Φ0) :: ?Ξ) ?p = Some ?D
                |- ind_lookup (gds_unseal ?Θ) ((?mq, ?Kq, gu_body ?Δ (gm_unseal ?Φ0)) :: gs_unseal ?Ξ) ?p = Some ?D =>
              exact (eq_trans (ind_lookup_unseal Θ ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ) p) Hq) end).
  all: cbn [gs_tele]; rewrite ?gu_params_unseal, ?gs_tele_unseal.
  all: intros; repeat match goal with
                 | Hq : ind_lookup (gds_unseal _) (gs_unseal _) _ = Some _ |- _ => rewrite ind_lookup_unseal in Hq
                 | Hq : record_lookup (gds_unseal _) (gs_unseal _) _ = Some _ |- _ => rewrite record_lookup_unseal in Hq
                 end.
  all: try rewrite !ind_lookup_unseal; try rewrite !ind_mlookup_unseal.
  all: try solve [ first [ eapply proj2; eauto | eauto ] ].
Qed.

Theorem unseal_preserves_wf :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> ⊢ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H') /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_unseal E) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ gm_unseal Φ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ).
Proof.
  pose proof unseal_preserves_wf_all as (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4 & _ & H6 & H7 & H8 & _ & H9 & H10 & H11).
  repeat split; intros; [ apply H1 | apply H2 | apply H3 | apply H4 | apply H6 | apply H7 | apply H8 | apply H9 | apply H10 | apply H11 ]; assumption.
Qed.

Corollary unseal_exp : forall Θ Ξ Γ A M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A.
Proof. apply unseal_preserves_wf. Qed.

Corollary unseal_exp_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A.
Proof. apply unseal_preserves_wf. Qed.

Corollary unseal_subtyp : forall Θ Ξ Γ A A',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'.
Proof. apply unseal_preserves_wf. Qed.

Corollary unseal_gctx : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ gds_unseal Θ ⍮ gs_unseal Ξ.
Proof. apply unseal_preserves_wf. Qed.

Global Contexts without Axioms

Every definition has a body, at every depth of nesting; an alias declares no definition of its own. Transparency is not asked for.
ge_no_axioms E: every definition in E has a body; mutually, gm_no_axioms for module bodies.
Fixpoint ge_no_axioms (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ _ _ B => B <> None
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk _ (md_body sm Φ)) => gm_no_axioms Φ
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk _ (md_alias _)) => True
  | ge_ind _ _ _ _ Φ => gm_no_axioms Φ
  | ge_def_mod _ _ _ _ => True
  | ge_record _ _ _ Φ => gm_no_axioms Φ
  end
with gm_no_axioms (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ _ E => gm_no_axioms Φ /\ ge_no_axioms E
  | gm_open Φ _ _ Φg => gm_no_axioms Φ /\ gm_no_axioms Φg
  end.

Definition gds_no_axioms (Θ : gdeps) : Prop :=
  forall fp U, List.In (fp, U) Θ -> gm_no_axioms (gu_mod U).

Definition gs_no_axioms (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  forall mp K U, List.In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> gm_no_axioms (gu_mod U).

Definition gc_no_axioms (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop := gds_no_axioms Θ /\ gs_no_axioms Ξ.

Lemma gm_no_axioms_unseal_transparent : forall Φ, gm_no_axioms Φ -> gm_transparent (gm_unseal Φ).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] HΦ; cbn in *; [ exact I | | exact (IH _ (proj1 HΦ)) ].
  destruct HΦ as [HΦ HE]; split; [ exact (IH _ HΦ) |].
  destruct E as [b pv r A [M |] | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? Φ' | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ?]; cbn in *;
    [ split; congruence | contradiction | exact (IH _ HE) | exact I | exact (IH _ HE) | exact I | exact (IH _ HE) ].
Qed.

Lemma gds_unseal_in : forall Θ fp U',
    List.In (fp, U') (gds_unseal Θ) -> exists U, U' = gu_unseal U /\ List.In (fp, U) Θ.
Proof.
  induction Θ as [| [fq U] Θ IH]; intros * Hin; cbn in Hin; [ contradiction |].
  destruct Hin as [[= <- <-] | Hin]; [ exists U; cbn; auto |].
  destruct (IH _ _ Hin) as (U0 & -> & ?); exists U0; cbn; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gs_unseal_in : forall Ξ mp K U',
    List.In (mp, K, U') (gs_unseal Ξ) -> exists U, U' = gu_unseal U /\ List.In (mp, K, U) Ξ.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] U] Ξ IH]; intros * Hin; cbn in Hin; [ contradiction |].
  destruct Hin as [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; [ exists U; cbn; auto |].
  destruct (IH _ _ _ Hin) as (U0 & -> & ?); exists U0; cbn; auto.
Qed.

Without axioms, unsealing makes the global context transparent.
Theorem gc_no_axioms_unseal_transparent : forall Θ Ξ,
    gc_no_axioms Θ Ξ -> gc_transparent (gds_unseal Θ) (gs_unseal Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ]; split.
  - intros ? ? Hin; destruct (gds_unseal_in _ _ _ Hin) as (U0 & -> & Hin0).
    rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_no_axioms_unseal_transparent, (HΘ _ _ Hin0).
  - intros ? ? ? Hin; destruct (gs_unseal_in _ _ _ _ Hin) as (U0 & -> & Hin0).
    rewrite gu_mod_unseal; apply gm_no_axioms_unseal_transparent, (HΞ _ _ _ Hin0).
Qed.

A resolved definition without a body is an axiom.
Lemma gm_no_axioms_resolve : forall Φ ip b pv r A B,
    gm_no_axioms Φ -> gm_resolve Φ ip = Some (ge_def b pv r A B) -> B <> None.
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] ip b pv r A0 B0 HΦ H; cbn in H, HΦ; [ discriminate | | eapply IH; [ exact (proj1 HΦ) | exact H ] ].
  destruct HΦ as [HΦ HE].
  destruct ip as [| x ip']; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| eapply IH; eassumption ].
  destruct ip' as [| z ip''], E as [b' pv' r' A B | ? [Δ' [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? ? Φ' | ? ? ? ? | ? ? Φ']; try discriminate;
    first [ injection H as <- <- <- <- <-; exact HE | eapply IH; [ exact HE | exact H ] ].
Qed.

Lemma gc_no_axioms_resolve : forall Θ Ξ p b pv r A B,
    gc_no_axioms Θ Ξ ->
    gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def b pv r A B) ->
    B <> None.
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ] Hr.
  destruct (gc_resolve_inv _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(mp & K & U & ip & Hin & Hm) | (fp & U & Hl & Hm)].
  - exact (gm_no_axioms_resolve _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HΞ _ _ _ Hin) Hm).
  - exact (gm_no_axioms_resolve _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HΘ _ _ (gds_lookup_in _ _ _ Hl)) Hm).
Qed.

Running Commands Without Axioms

A command declares an axiom only as core_cmd_def with no body. A run of commands that declare none, loading units that declare none, files no axiom, so every global context it reaches has none: the consistency and canonicity theorems at gc_no_axioms hold of every such program.
A command as written declares no axiom, at any depth of nesting: a definition has a body, and so has every one in the body of a module or the with-area of a record.
Fixpoint cmd_no_axioms (c : surface_cmd) : Prop :=
  match c with
  | surface_cmd_def _ _ _ _ oM => oM <> None
  | surface_cmd_mod _ _ _ cs => List.fold_right (fun c P => cmd_no_axioms c /\ P) True cs
